data.title: Flight Schedule Commands
data.statement:
A flight information system stores one schedule record in this format:
[[S]] = FLIGHT|ORIGIN|DESTINATION|HH:MM

You receive [[N]] commands and apply them in order:
- SET_ORIGIN|XXX: replace the origin station with [[XXX]].
- SET_DEST|XXX: replace the destination station with [[XXX]].
- SET_DEPARTURE|HH:MM: replace the departure time.
- DELAY|M: delay departure by [[M]] minutes.
- SWAP_STATIONS: swap origin and destination.

For DELAY|M, time wraps around after 23:59.
All commands are valid.

testCases.testIn:

data.constraints:
1 <= |[[S]]| <= 200
1 <= [[N]] <= 50
[[S]], [[X]], [[A]], [[B]] contain no spaces and no |.
For CUT|L|R: 0 <= [[L]] <= [[R]] < current length.
0 <= [[K]] <= 1000000000
Current length never exceeds 300.

Line 1: string [[S]], formatted as FLIGHT|ORIGIN|DESTINATION|HH:MM.
Line 2: integer [[N]], number of commands.
Next [[N]] lines: one command in one of these forms:
- SET_ORIGIN|XXX
- SET_DEST|XXX
- SET_DEPARTURE|HH:MM
- DELAY|M
- SWAP_STATIONS
"@.Trim()

 = @"
1 <= [[N]] <= 30
All fields contain no spaces.
Station codes use uppercase letters.
0 <= [[M]] <= 10000

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

A flight information system stores one schedule record in this format:
S = FLIGHT|ORIGIN|DESTINATION|HH:MM

You receive N commands and apply them in order:
- SET_ORIGIN|XXX: replace the origin station with XXX.
- SET_DEST|XXX: replace the destination station with XXX.
- SET_DEPARTURE|HH:MM: replace the departure time.
- DELAY|M: delay departure by M minutes.
- SWAP_STATIONS: swap origin and destination.

For DELAY|M, time wraps around after 23:59.
All commands are valid.
Input
Line 1: string S, formatted as FLIGHT|ORIGIN|DESTINATION|HH:MM.
Line 2: integer N, number of commands.
Next N lines: one command in one of these forms:
- SET_ORIGIN|XXX
- SET_DEST|XXX
- SET_DEPARTURE|HH:MM
- DELAY|M
- SWAP_STATIONS
"@.Trim()

= @"
1 <= N <= 30
All fields contain no spaces.
Station codes use uppercase letters.
0 <= M <= 10000
Output
Print the final schedule in the same format: FLIGHT|ORIGIN|DESTINATION|HH:MM.
Constraints
1 <= |S| <= 200
1 <= N <= 50
S, X, A, B contain no spaces and no |.
For CUT|L|R: 0 <= L <= R < current length.
0 <= K <= 1000000000
Current length never exceeds 300.
Example
Input
CG101|MNL|DXB|08:30
4
SET_ORIGIN|CEB
DELAY|45
SET_DEST|SIN
SWAP_STATIONS
Output
CG101|SIN|CEB|09:15
